title: Plex Watch-Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tautulli:play
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(duration_s) as secs by user _time
| eval hours=round(secs/3600,1)
| sort - hours
description: Ranks who watched the most on your Plex server each month, the friendly leaderboard every home media server deserves.
value: A watch-time leaderboard is pure fun and also tells you who your server is really for when you plan upgrades.
implementation: Forward Tautulli playback events to HEC; schedule monthly and share the leaderboard with your household.
visualization: Bar chart of monthly watch hours by user.
grandmaExplanation: It shows who watched the most on your home movie server each month, like a family leaderboard.
